demoName: GAZ-208: Loan Repayment and Transaction Verification
demoDescription: Interactive flow showing real-time loan repayment and ledger reconciliation using Apache Fineract existing components.

1.title: Select Origin Client
1.details: Access the existing Client component to identify the sender and verify account status.

2.title: Initiate Loan Repayment
2.details: Execute repayment via Fineract business logic. Technical Endpoint: /fineract-provider/api/v1/loans/1/transactions?command=repayment

3.title: Confirm Transaction Settlement
3.details: Verify the transaction ledger to ensure funds have been successfully moved and reconciled in the system.
